status: DESCRIPTIVE ENGINE-BACKED STUDY; NOT OFFICIAL GRADE OR POWERED COMPARISON

prefill.note: Etalon 4.1: D_p is a function of prompt length and should be re-fit from the prefill_calibration cell on the pilot; constants here are placeholders, not measurements.

strict.rationale: Etalon 5 uses a 25 ms TBT SLO as the strict tier (40 tok/s).

medium.rationale: 20 tok/s: comfortable interactive reading plus headroom.

relaxed.rationale: Etalon 2.2: 250 words/min ~ 6 tok/s is the reading-speed floor.

token_accounting.method: verified pinned output tokenizer for real captures; task-local regex only for mock output and approximate prompt lengths
token_accounting.note: Counts re-encode completed output, not hidden engine IDs. Prompt length remains an approximate covariate. Do not tighten the usage band until parity is measured.

client_integrity.note: Runs whose client lagged more than this during the measurement phase are invalid: the client, not the server, would own the timing.

procedure: cold start the pinned engine container (clock starts at launch)
poll readiness_endpoint every 1 s; record each probe; readiness never stops the clock
issue probe generations every 2 s; the first one that is a VALID completed generation stops the clock
startup.note: Startup stops at the first valid completed deterministic one-integer generation using the same fixed assistant-prefill profile. This tiny-generation readiness endpoint is explicit and does not represent chat-answer duration. planning_cold_start_s remains an unmeasured placeholder until real cold launches.

warmup.note: Excluded from every statistic; recorded with phase=warmup so the population table still accounts for them.

cache_state.fallback_if_unsupported: A deterministic request-specific leading user-content nonce prevents identical user prefixes. Shared chat-template state and coincidental short token prefixes remain unflushed; engine block-cache behavior is not asserted.

planning_assumptions.status: UNMEASURED planning inputs; actual no-flush default uses nonce isolation. Do not treat arithmetic or the safety cushion as measured duration.

statistics.decision: two-sided bootstrap percentile CI of the paired-cell difference; regression only if the CI excludes zero AND the point estimate exceeds min_effect; inconclusive if the CI straddles the min_effect boundary; family-wise correction = Bonferroni across compared cells per metric
statistics.diagnostic_qualification: Small fixed n: percentile intervals are descriptive; no power, promotion, regression-discrimination probability or full-suite comparison claim.

pruned_redundancy: Calibration is captured once in a separate mode and never refitted from scored data.
All four original scored chat rates are retained: A/A controls do not substitute for a cross-run comparison load point.
No-flush default has zero explicit cache-flush delay. Request-specific leading nonces reduce shared user-prefix reuse; common chat-template state is not flushed.
design_revision.statistics: Three repetitions and the sample floor are starting policies, not proof of power. Use pilot noise/CI widths to freeze sufficient counts before comparisons; retain inconclusive results when evidence is weak.
design_revision.runtime: Full suite hard ceiling remains10800s including setup/cleanup/export, enforced by capture.py; planning estimates are not deadlines.
design_revision.request_profile: One fixed assistant empty-thinking prefill and continuation flags apply identically to startup, warmup, calibration and scoring. Generated user instructions remain unchanged; source budgets are explicit, including the documented long-generation feasibility correction. No arbitrary messages or body overrides are accepted.
design_revision.sequence_feasibility: Preserve the original 200..320 endpoint range. The pinned target tokenizer needs 1172 output tokens for canonical 1..320 plus newline, so the long-generation cap is 1280; other source caps stay unchanged. This adds 108 tokens of textual headroom without relaxing exact sequence correctness.
